description: One band covers the whole day; no day/night split has been given. Order is the owner's preferred runway mode list, strict: 1 24A21AD; 2 03AD06D. The four single-runway fallback modes (21AD, 03AD, 24AD, 06AD) are not from the owner: they share the lowest priority, equal, and tie-break by file order. The penalties are placeholders on the same scale as the other packs (0, 2, 20) for the owner to confirm.
